plugins.description: Work through Jot feedback: bug reports and change requests that people pinned to elements of the live app, with screenshots and recordings. Use when the user mentions Jot, feedback, a bug report, a pin or a comment id, or asks what is open, to fix reported issues, or to reply to reviewers.
